title: Refine MeghRaj Exports site to soft luxury theme (glass cards, palette, typography, nav/hero/modal polish) without layout changes

requirements.text: Update the global theme tokens and base styles to match the provided soft-luxury palette and reduce the current overly-dark/flat look, while avoiding pure white as the dominant background. Apply: Primary Navy #0E1A2B, Warm Background #F4F1EA, Light Bluish Section Tint #EEF2F7, Accent Gold #C5A24D, Primary Text #1F2A3A, Muted Text #5C677D. Ensure body/background defaults, card/popover colors, border/input colors, and text colors produce strong readability (no white-on-white).

quotes:
Update the design to a soft luxury theme with subtle depth and glass effect.
Use this color system:
Primary Navy:
#0E1A2B

#F4F1EA

#EEF2F7

Primary Text:

Do NOT use pure white backgrounds everywhere.
Alternate warm off-white and very soft bluish sections for visual balance.

acceptanceCriteria: Global CSS variables in frontend/src/index.css reflect the specified palette (either directly as hex or as equivalent OKLCH values) and the default page background is warm/off-white rather than pure white or deep navy.
Foreground/body text uses #1F2A3A-equivalent (theme foreground) and muted text uses #5C677D-equivalent (theme muted-foreground), with readable contrast across all pages.
At least two section background treatments exist (warm off-white and very soft bluish tint) and are used across pages without altering layout/structure.

requirements.text: Implement a consistent glassmorphism card style and apply it to all cards: product cards, subcategory cards, feature cards, and modal content container. Glass style must use: background rgba(255,255,255,0.65), backdrop blur 12px, border-radius 12px, 1px border rgba(197,162,77,0.25), and a soft subtle shadow (no heavy shadows, no glow, no strong gradients).

quotes:
2️⃣ GLASS CARD EFFECT (ALL CARDS)
Apply glassmorphism style to:
Product cards
Subcategory cards
Feature cards
Modal content container
Card styling:
background: rgba(255,255,255,0.65)
backdrop-filter: blur(12px)
border-radius: 12px
border: 1px solid rgba(197,162,77,0.25)
box-shadow: soft and subtle
No heavy shadows.
No strong gradients.

acceptanceCriteria: A reusable glass card class/utility exists (e.g., in frontend/src/index.css Tailwind layer) matching the specified background/blur/border/radius/shadow constraints.

Cards in ProductsPage (category cards), CategoryHierarchy (subcategory cards), HomePage highlights cards, About/Catalogue info callouts, and SubcategoryCard all render with the glass card styling without changing their structure or content.
Hover states remain subtle (no heavy shadow jumps); any hover border emphasis uses gold at low opacity.

requirements.text: Fix typography, spacing, and contrast site-wide to improve readability while preserving existing structure: increase body text line-height where needed, ensure headings feel elegant/strong, remove any cases of white text on near-white backgrounds, and increase section padding to create breathing space without changing layout composition.

quotes:
3️⃣ TEXT READABILITY FIX
Ensure:
No white text on white backgrounds
Use deep navy text (#1F2A3A)
Increase body text line height
Improve contrast across all sections
Increase section padding for breathing space
Headings must feel elegant and strong.

acceptanceCriteria: No section with light background uses white text for headings/body copy; text colors follow the new foreground/muted palette.
Body copy line-height is consistently comfortable (no cramped paragraphs) across Home/About/Catalogue/Products/Subcategory/Contact pages.
Section padding increases are implemented via styling only (class changes), with no route/component restructuring.

requirements.text: Restrict Accent Gold usage to premium highlights only: button backgrounds, thin divider lines, card hover borders, and active navigation underline. Remove/avoid other decorative gold usage so it remains minimal and premium.

quotes:
4️⃣ GOLD ACCENT USAGE
Use gold only for:
Button backgrounds
Thin divider lines
Card hover borders
Active navigation underline
Do NOT overuse gold.
Gold must feel premium, not decorative.

acceptanceCriteria: Buttons that are primary actions use gold as the background, with readable text color.
Dividers remain thin and subtle; gold is not used as large fills or broad backgrounds.
Card hover effects use a subtle gold border emphasis rather than strong glow/gradient.
Navigation active state uses a thin gold underline (not a filled pill/tab).

requirements.text: Refine the navigation/header styling to a soft translucent white look with blur and dark navy text (not white), including a thin gold underline for the active link. Remove heavy fills/strong backgrounds for both desktop and mobile navigation states while keeping the same navigation structure and behavior.

quotes:
5️⃣ NAVIGATION REFINEMENT
Header background:
Soft translucent white with blur effect.
Text:
Dark navy.
Active link:
Thin gold underline.
Remove heavy fills or strong backgrounds.

acceptanceCriteria: Header uses a translucent light surface with backdrop blur on all routes (including the home page) and uses dark text by default.
Active desktop nav item shows a thin gold underline; inactive items use muted text and become foreground on hover.
Mobile nav avoids heavy filled active backgrounds; active state is indicated primarily via thin gold accent/underline/border.
No changes to nav items, routes, or header layout structure.

requirements.text: Refine the Home page hero section styling: keep the hero image strong, add a subtle overlay gradient behind the text area only (not across the entire hero), and ensure hero text remains highly readable with the new palette (avoid overly dark full-screen overlays).

quotes:
6️⃣ HERO SECTION REFINEMENT
Keep hero image strong.
Add subtle overlay gradient behind text only (not entire screen).
Text must remain highly readable.

acceptanceCriteria: Hero overlay is localized to the text region (e.g., a positioned gradient panel), not a full-width full-opacity dark wash over the entire hero image.
Hero heading and subheading maintain high contrast and readability without relying on pure white-on-white combinations.
Hero buttons follow the gold/secondary styling rules and remain legible over the image.

requirements.text: Refine modal styling to match the soft luxury theme: modal content container uses an off-white surface with slight blur, a thin gold border, elegant spacing, and the same glassmorphism card treatment; keep the existing modal structure and interactions (ESC, click outside, scroll lock).

quotes:
7️⃣ MODAL REFINEMENT
Modal background:
Soft off-white with slight blur.
Add thin gold border.
Keep layout elegant and spacious.

acceptanceCriteria: ProductQuickViewModal panel uses the glass card style (or a modal-specific glass variant) with a thin gold border and soft shadow; no heavy glow/gradients.
Modal backdrop remains subtle and does not darken the screen excessively; blur remains present.
Close button styling remains accessible and consistent with the new palette.

requirements.text: Update the footer styling to match the soft luxury theme and readability rules: avoid dark-only footer treatment with white headings on a light background, ensure footer headings and links use the correct foreground/muted colors, and keep gold accents minimal (links/dividers only).

quotes:
The current design is too white and flat.

Ensure:

Use deep navy text (#1F2A3A)
Improve contrast across all sections

acceptanceCriteria: Footer background and text colors are consistent with the global theme and maintain strong contrast.
Footer headings are not forced to white on a light background; link hover states remain subtle and premium.
Existing footer content/structure (company info, quick links, contact, caffeine.ai referral) remains unchanged.

constraints: Do not change the site structure, routing, or component layout; implement visual styling refinements only.
Do not introduce heavy shadows, glow effects, strong gradients, or overly dark backgrounds.
Do not overuse gold; restrict it to the specified accent use cases.
Do not edit files under frontend/src/components/ui or any paths listed as immutable in SYSTEM_CONTEXT.
nonGoals: Adding new pages, sections, or rearranging existing page layouts.
Changing backend behavior or data models (no backend work required).
Adding new authentication methods or third-party integrations.
